title: Hornussen
tagline: Bend the rod, strike the Nouss, stop it with timed boards
description: The Swiss field sport on your phone: press and hold to bend the long rod, aim across the Ries and release for a perfect whip. Then swap sides and tap your fielders to throw wooden boards into the flying puck. Four Alpine venues, three levels, Hints and a full Auto Play.
howToPlay: Press and hold anywhere to bend the rod; slide left or right to aim.
Release in the gold zone of the meter for a perfect whip.
A puck that lands in the Ries scores 1, 2 or 3 points by distance.
When fielding, tap the fielder the ring marks as it closes.
A board that is up as the puck passes stops it: no points.
The side with more points after both halves wins.
